records.abstract: Cu-Al-Ni shape memory alloys (SMAs) are promising solid-solid phase-change materials (PCMs) for transient thermal management. Data-driven screening for high-latent-heat (Δ H ) Cu-Al-Ni PCMs across the vast compositional space is efficient, but predictive accuracy and screening reliability degrade when noisy experimental data are used. A noise-aware machine learning strategy was applied to accelerate the discovery of high-Δ H Cu-Al-Ni alloys with martensite start temperature ( M s ) within the 100-200 °C range from noisy experimental datasets.
